resources.string: Floating bubble that saves opportunities to your tracker

Shows a small floating bubble. When you tap it, Follow-Through reads the text on your screen, the page link and a screenshot, and sends them to your own Google Sheet so the opportunity can be tracked. Nothing on your screen is read until you tap the bubble, and password fields are always skipped. If Scroll guard is on, it also notes which app is open (only the app's name) to nudge you when you've been scrolling too long.
